why: Lanes 16 to 18 replay SBX-66 on the Codex stand-in: a run branch that moves under three Implement attempts, so Land finds a new conflict after each rework, checks that stay red through three reworks, so Land parks for failed checks, and a run branch that never stops moving, so Land parks for conflicts. They prove conflicts and failed checks count apart and that each park names its own cause (D2), and the feature map names all three (C3).
